sentences.en: The photo brought back many happy memories of my childhood.
sentences.zh: 这张照片勾起了我童年的许多美好回忆。

sentences.en: The photo catches the tension in the court very well.
sentences.zh: 这张照片很好地捕捉了法庭上的紧张气氛。

sentences.en: I can't look at this photo without feeling very sad.
sentences.zh: 每次看这张照片我都感到非常难过。
